name: Conti
description: Conti was a Russian ransomware-as-a-service group with over 100 salaried employees that targeted companies with $100M+ in annual revenue. The group's internal chat logs were leaked by a Ukrainian researcher in February 2022 after Conti announced support for Russia's invasion of Ukraine, revealing detailed operations including payroll, recruitment, and technical infrastructure. Conti used the Trickbot botnet for deployment and pioneered multi-stage extortion. The group dissolved in mid-2022 after the leak.

sources.title: Conti Ransomware Group Diaries, Part I: Evasion — Krebs on Security
